functions.name: Open the workbench page
functions.behaviour: Loads the experiment page for one token and mode (g1 opens on the Keys tab with the keyboard strip shown; g2 hides the keyboard strip), fetches structure, snapshot and mesh assets, starts the renderer and shows a status message.
functions.notes: URL query parameters token and mode (g1|g2) select the session token and layout; they are read at app.js:9. Mesh binary assets are fetched from /assets/ (app.js:149-150).

functions.name: Command index
functions.behaviour: Opens a searchable list of every command that is not form-only; clicking a row closes the list and runs that command.
entry_points: control Command index: Search an action
button Command index: command row (one per listed command)
functions.notes: F1 also works while a text field has focus (keys.js:202-203 allows F1/F2 text navigation).

functions.name: Open keyboard-bank chooser
functions.behaviour: Opens a dialog listing banks with their orbit, buffers, captured caps and requirements, searchable by ID or purpose; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the selection and a single search match selects itself.
entry_points: button Keys tab: Choose bank by ID
control Keyboard banks dialog: Bank ID or purpose search
button Keyboard banks dialog: bank row
functions.notes: The Orbit 33 button in the context bar is declared data-command="bank" in index.html:5 but rebound to "orbit" after startup (app.js:300).

functions.name: Activate selected bank
functions.behaviour: Switches the workspace to the bank highlighted in the chooser, closes it and reports its purpose and requirements.
entry_points: button Keyboard banks dialog: Activate selected bank
functions.notes: Enter is handled only when focus is in the bank search field.

functions.name: Previous bank
functions.behaviour: Returns to the previously active bank.
entry_points: button Keyboard banks dialog: Previous bank

functions.name: Rename current bank
functions.behaviour: Opens a name field for the current bank and saves a new display name.
entry_points: button Keyboard banks dialog: Rename current
button Rename current bank dialog: Save name

functions.name: Switch bank by suffix
functions.behaviour: Switches to the bank of the current orbit with suffix A, B, I, M or E.
functions.notes: Bindings are the defaults; user key mappings (Edit keys) can replace them.

functions.name: Choose orbit by structure
functions.behaviour: Opens a searchable list of orbits described by hosting cells, affecting caps and orientation, with a 4D diagram of the highlighted orbit.
entry_points: control Orbit dialog: Orbit structure search

functions.name: Use chosen orbit
functions.behaviour: Makes the highlighted orbit the active orbit and closes the dialog.
entry_points: button Orbit dialog: Use this orbit

functions.name: Open or close Macro Base drawer
functions.behaviour: Shows or hides the macro library panel and focuses its search when opened.

functions.name: Search macros (key)
functions.behaviour: Opens the Macro Base panel and focuses its search field.
functions.notes: F3 is bound to macro-search; the Macro Base button label also shows F3 but dispatches library-toggle.

functions.name: Filter the macro list
functions.behaviour: Filters the macro list by text (name, note, ID), by scope (active orbit or all) and by kind (all, star, personal, orientation).
entry_points: control Macro Base panel: Search macros
control Macro Base panel: Macro orbit scope
control Macro Base panel: Macro classification

functions.name: Select a macro
functions.behaviour: Selecting a macro row loads its exact effect, shows it on the canvas and explains applicability.
entry_points: mouse Macro Base panel: click macro row

functions.name: Drag a macro into a phase
functions.behaviour: Dragging a macro row onto 01 Prepare, 02 Macro or 03 Cleanup inserts it into that draft phase.
entry_points: mouse Macro Base panel: drag macro row
mouse Operation desk: drop on phase button

functions.name: Insert selected macro into a phase
functions.behaviour: Adds the selected macro to the Prepare, Macro or Cleanup phase of the draft (Macro replaces; Prepare and Cleanup append).
entry_points: button Macro detail: Use as Macro

functions.name: Show exact operation effects
functions.behaviour: Opens a dialog with the selected or reviewed operation: category, slot count, support, cycles, fixed orientation and the first slot pairs.

functions.name: Enter a concrete macro
functions.behaviour: Opens a form to name a macro and give its native JSON recipe and note, then validates and saves it as a personal macro.
entry_points: button Macro dialog: Validate and save

functions.name: Edit macro name and notes
functions.behaviour: Opens the selected macro name and note for editing and saves them.
entry_points: button Macro Base panel: Name / notes
button Macro notes dialog: Save notes

functions.name: Compare two macros
functions.behaviour: Opens two macro selectors and reports full net equality, inverse relation and orbits where the effects are locally equal.
entry_points: button Compare dialog: Compare full model

functions.name: Open Current piece dialog
functions.behaviour: Opens a dialog to set Current to an identity and a fixed destination position by typed ID.
functions.notes: Typed IDs are parsed by ids.js parseId (identity prefix I, position prefix P, bare decimals).

functions.name: Pick structural example pieces
functions.behaviour: On the Keys tab, sample buttons make a preset piece Current: a 1-cell, 2-cell/18-cap, the 5-cell example and a 20-cell piece.

functions.name: Locate Next
functions.behaviour: Selects the locked Next piece for inspection and moves the puzzle camera to its first cell without changing Current or destination.

functions.name: Pin Next
functions.behaviour: Locks the inspected identity as the Next bookmark; if one exists, asks for explicit replacement first.
entry_points: button Locked Next dialog: Replace with inspected identity
button Replace Next dialog: Replace Next explicitly

functions.name: Clear Next
functions.behaviour: Removes the Next bookmark.
entry_points: button Locked Next dialog: Clear bookmark

functions.name: Activate Next
functions.behaviour: Explicitly makes the locked Next piece the Current piece (draft edit recorded for draft undo).
entry_points: button Locked Next dialog: Activate explicitly
functions.notes: The Activate button is disabled when no Next is set (app.js:88).

functions.name: Manage locked Next menu
functions.behaviour: Opens a dialog showing the bookmark with Locate, Replace, Clear and Activate choices.

functions.name: Add piece to block
functions.behaviour: Adds the inspected identity as a requirement of the working block.

functions.name: Protect position
functions.behaviour: Preserves the exact labels at the inspected position at the complete-operation boundary.

functions.name: Assign A / B buffer roles
functions.behaviour: Opens a form to set the two buffer positions A and B and saves them in the work context.

functions.name: Set explicit reference word
functions.behaviour: Opens the reference-word editor; saving stores the word, and a second button transforms the selected macro to R⁻¹ Macro R and saves it.
entry_points: button Reference dialog: Use this reference word
button Reference dialog: Save selected macro under reference

functions.name: Switch canvas tab
functions.behaviour: Switches the central canvas between Work, Reference and Keys; key F6 cycles them.

functions.name: Show Local view
functions.behaviour: Opens the linked views drawer with the Local piece structure diagram.

functions.name: Show Global view
functions.behaviour: Opens the linked views drawer with the 4D Global diagram of two cell groups.

functions.name: Show puzzle layout
functions.behaviour: Opens the linked views drawer in the puzzle layout and refits the viewport.

functions.name: Close linked views
functions.behaviour: Closes the right drawer and returns focus.

functions.name: Dismiss panels with Escape
functions.behaviour: Escape (no dialog open) closes the linked views, puzzle layout and Macro Base drawer and focuses the canvas.
functions.notes: Escape inside an open dialog is handled by the native dialog and closes it.

functions.name: Close dialog
functions.behaviour: The × button or Escape closes any open dialog; keyboard grips reset and focus returns to the previous control.
functions.notes: Escape is native browser dialog behaviour; the close handler is app.js:166.

functions.name: Open Piece Filter
functions.behaviour: Opens a dialog to type a filter expression, choose Replace/Intersect/Union/Subtract, use presets and select saved filters.
entry_points: button Filter dialog: Active orbit preset
button Filter dialog: Unsolved active preset
button Filter dialog: All pieces preset
button Filter dialog: Orientation only preset

functions.name: Preview filter counts
functions.behaviour: Shows the counts and results of a filter expression without applying it.

functions.name: Apply filter
functions.behaviour: Applies the filter expression with the chosen operation; it changes display and picking only.

functions.name: Save current filter
functions.behaviour: Saves the current filter under a name.

functions.name: View committed or draft result
functions.behaviour: Switches the canvas and puzzle between committed state and the proposed draft result (Draft result runs a review first).

functions.name: Edit a draft phase
functions.behaviour: Opens a JSON recipe editor for Prepare, Macro or Cleanup and applies it to the draft only.
entry_points: button Keys tab: Inspect entered word
button Edit phase dialog: Apply draft edit

functions.name: Choose input destination and phase
functions.behaviour: Selects whether turns go to the Draft or the Live puzzle and which phase (Prepare, Macro, Cleanup) receives them; saves the choice.

functions.name: Undo draft edit
functions.behaviour: Restores the previous draft within this browser window (up to 30 edits).
functions.notes: The undo history is browser-local (draftUndo array).

functions.name: Cleanup equals Prepare inverse
functions.behaviour: Fills the Cleanup phase with the inverse of Prepare.

functions.name: Open work sheets
functions.behaviour: Opens a dialog to save the current draft as a named work sheet or reuse a saved one.

functions.name: Save work sheet
functions.behaviour: Stores the current fixed draft steps under a name.
entry_points: button Work sheets dialog: Save current

functions.name: Reuse work sheet
functions.behaviour: Loads the fixed steps of a saved work sheet into the draft.
entry_points: button Work sheets dialog: Reuse fixed steps

functions.name: Review complete operation
functions.behaviour: Reviews the whole draft (prepare, macro, cleanup) for protection and prefix conflicts and shows the result.

functions.name: Preview operation
functions.behaviour: Creates a pending preview of the reviewed operation (button enabled only when the review is Ready).

functions.name: Commit preview
functions.behaviour: Commits the pending preview through the Session and refreshes the state.

functions.name: Cancel preview
functions.behaviour: Discards the pending preview.

functions.name: Cancel analysis
functions.behaviour: Requests cancellation of the running analysis job; committed state is preserved. Visible only while an operation is busy.

functions.name: Open protection dialog
functions.behaviour: Opens orbit locks and position-lock management with a prefix-preservation option and the current review conflicts; the protection summary button and conflict buttons open it.
entry_points: button Macro detail: Conflict in orbit pieces

functions.name: Apply protection policy
functions.behaviour: Applies the checked orbit locks and strict prefix policy.
functions.notes: Issues two commands in sequence (protect, then prefix).

functions.name: Clear position locks
functions.behaviour: Removes every position lock after an explicit click.
entry_points: button Protection dialog: Clear position locks explicitly
functions.notes: Issues block-protect with enabled=false per locked position.

functions.name: Inspect a conflicting position
functions.behaviour: Selecting a block conflict button inspects the protected position.
entry_points: button Macro detail: Conflict at position

functions.name: Open capture dialog
functions.behaviour: Opens a form for the 20 Grip slots to map explicit canonical cells, with source helpers for hosting cells, affecting caps and Buffer A/B caps.
entry_points: button Keys tab: Capture selected structure
button Capture dialog: Selected hosting cells
button Capture dialog: Selected affecting caps
button Capture dialog: Buffer A caps
button Capture dialog: Buffer B caps

functions.name: Apply grip capture
functions.behaviour: Saves the Grip-to-cap mapping for the current bank after checking there are no gaps.
entry_points: button Capture dialog: Apply explicit capture

functions.name: Edit key bindings
functions.behaviour: Opens JSON for command, twist and grip key mappings; shows defaults; saves (twenty grip codes required); exports as a JSON download.
entry_points: button Key bindings dialog: Show editable defaults
button Key bindings dialog: Save mappings
functions.notes: Export writes a browser download named magic600-keys.json; it is not an engine write.

functions.name: Show or hide keyboard strip
functions.behaviour: Toggles the on-screen keyboard strip of Grip and Twist keys.

functions.name: Choose Hold or Latch grip
functions.behaviour: Selects whether a Grip is held while a key is down or latched by pressing again.

functions.name: Select a Grip with a physical key
functions.behaviour: A Grip key chooses one fixed cap C1–C600 from the active bank mapping; in Hold mode it is active while held, in Latch mode a repeat toggles it. Several held grips cancel the choice.
functions.notes: Default codes; each slot maps to the cap captured for that slot in the current bank. Shift+key is not a Grip. Unassigned slots are inert.

functions.name: Select a Grip with the on-screen key
functions.behaviour: Clicking an on-screen grip key selects that cap as the pointer grip; clicking it again releases it.
entry_points: button Keyboard strip: grip key (slot buttons)
mouse Keyboard strip: click grip key

functions.name: Turn with a physical Twist key
functions.behaviour: With one Grip active, a Twist key appends the legal word for the H or T axis (Shift inverts) to the chosen destination and phase.
functions.notes: Default axes: KeyA=H1, KeyS=H2, KeyD=H3, KeyF=T1, KeyG=T2, KeyH=T3, KeyJ=T4. Destination Live commits the turn through the Session; Draft appends to the draft. Rejected while busy, in a dialog, in a text field, or with no single grip.

functions.name: Turn with an on-screen Twist key
functions.behaviour: Clicking an on-screen twist button applies that axis to the active grip, inverted when the Inverse toggle or Shift is down.
entry_points: mouse Keyboard strip: click twist key

functions.name: Toggle Inverse for on-screen twists
functions.behaviour: Latches inverse mode for on-screen Twist buttons.

functions.name: Reset the camera view
functions.behaviour: Resets only the puzzle camera and fit.

functions.name: Locate Current in the puzzle
functions.behaviour: Moves the puzzle camera to the first cell of the Current piece.

functions.name: Locate inspected selection
functions.behaviour: Shows the puzzle and focuses the camera on the selected cell or inspected piece.

functions.name: Choose puzzle render mode
functions.behaviour: Chooses Adaptive, Full mesh or Point glyphs for the viewport and rebuilds it.
entry_points: control Linked views: Puzzle render mode

functions.name: Pick a sticker in the puzzle
functions.behaviour: Clicking a sticker in the puzzle inspects its piece (only for the committed frame); Shift+click also opens the Current dialog.
functions.notes: Camera drag, zoom and any other pointer gestures are implemented in /web/renderer.js, which is not in this shard.

functions.name: Inspect piece from a diagram token
functions.behaviour: Clicking or pressing Enter/Space on an identity token in the canvas or Local panel inspects that piece.

functions.name: Inspect fixed position from a diagram
functions.behaviour: Clicking or pressing Enter/Space on a position socket inspects that fixed position.

functions.name: Select a cell in a diagram
functions.behaviour: Clicking a cell marker or cell row in a Local, Global or Reference diagram selects it for inspection only; the camera and grip mapping stay unchanged.

functions.name: Open Session dialog
functions.behaviour: Opens the isolated session panel with undo, redo, checkpoint, restore, reset, export and stop controls and the source note.

functions.name: Load E1 practice
functions.behaviour: Loads the synthetic E1 practice state through a legal explicit recipe and sets up its block.
entry_points: button Session dialog: Load explicit E1 practice

functions.name: Undo committed move
functions.behaviour: Undoes the last committed operation.

functions.name: Redo committed move
functions.behaviour: Redoes the last undone operation.

functions.name: Save checkpoint
functions.behaviour: Saves a named checkpoint of the current state and workspace.

functions.name: Restore checkpoint
functions.behaviour: Restores the selected checkpoint and the work context saved with it.

functions.name: Reset puzzle
functions.behaviour: Resets the isolated puzzle to solved, keeping the previous solve in a recovery checkpoint.
entry_points: button Session dialog: Reset puzzle with recovery point

functions.name: Export work definitions
functions.behaviour: Downloads the workspace (macros, templates, banks, keys, filters) as magic600-experimental-work.json.
entry_points: button Session dialog: Export work definitions
functions.notes: Browser download of state.workspace; no server write.

functions.name: Stop the experiment engine
functions.behaviour: Shuts the isolated engine down after reading its launch ID; the page reports that the engine stopped.

functions.name: Copy selection ID
functions.behaviour: Copies the inspected identity ID text to the clipboard.
functions.notes: Reachable only through the Command index; no default key or button. Writes the browser clipboard.

internal_only.name: ids.js ID formatting and parsing (formatIdentity, parseId, cellFromSlot, labCellIndex)
internal_only.reason: Used by Current, Roles and Capture dialogs and diagrams (command focus-apply, roles-apply, capture-apply).

internal_only.name: graphics.js diagram builders (workspaceDiagram, localDiagram, globalDiagram)
internal_only.reason: Render the canvas, Local and Reference diagrams; reached through tab, local, global commands.

internal_only.name: KeyboardRouter input-context guards (focus, blur, IME, hidden window, busy)
internal_only.reason: Reached through any keydown in the window; reset or reject keys, no own entry point.

internal_only.name: Job polling for long engine operations
internal_only.reason: Reached from every command that returns a job; polls route GET /api/job/<id>.

internal_only.name: Canvas focus scroll and overflow hint
internal_only.reason: Reached from focusing a diagram control or resizing the canvas.

internal_only.name: Renderer wiring (installRender, initializeRenderer)
internal_only.reason: Reached from start() and every snapshot with render data.

unclear.name: graphics.js blockDiagram and operationDiagram exports
unclear.reason: Exported but not imported by app.js; no reachable entry point found.

unclear.name: globalDiagram angle parameter
unclear.reason: No caller passes an angle; rotation is fixed at 0 and no control exists.

unclear.name: index.html Orbit button data-command="bank" versus runtime "orbit"
unclear.reason: The HTML default is replaced after startup; before startup dispatch ignores input.
